top_signals.title: Consumers Are Signaling an Uneven Economy, Abby Joseph Cohen Says
top_signals.summary: Abby Joseph Cohen, Columbia Business School professor and former partner at Goldman Sachs, says recent consumer spending patterns are signaling issues with the US economy. Speaking on "Bloomberg The Close," she also warns AI investing may not be sustainable and previews the Jackson Hole Federal Reserve meeting. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: City leaders weigh employment policy alternatives to non-competes
top_signals.summary: City businesses are expecting non-compete agreements to become less effective, looking instead to alternatives such as deferred bonus payments or share incentive plans to keep employees on board.
